_instruction: Always test and mark 'passes: true' before moving to the next item. Do not skip ahead.

phases.description: Compact resolver — unified entry point for all three triggers (auto/command/tool)
steps: Create src/session/compact-resolver.ts
Define CompactMethodDef interface: { id, description, parameters, execute }
Define CompactMethodContext: sessionId, messages, parts, modelMessages, model, agentPrompt, budget, persist
Define CompactResult: { type: 'compacted' | 'handoff', ... }
Implement resolve() that receives trigger (auto/command/tool), resolves configured method, calls method.execute()
Add deduplication — prevent concurrent compaction on the same session
Add pending state — if loop is active, queue request; if idle, run immediately
Test: calling resolve() twice for same session only runs once
Test: resolve() with unknown method throws descriptive error

phases.description: Anchored compaction engine — the default CompactMethodDef
steps: Create src/session/methods/anchored.ts as a CompactMethodDef
Parameters: retain_turns (number), prompt (string, has default), custom_instructions (string, optional)
Step 1: Split messages into evicted span (old) and retained tail (recent N turns)
Step 2: Prune tool outputs from evicted span before sending to LLM (biggest token savings)
Step 3: Send evicted span + compaction prompt to model, get structured summary
Step 4: If prior anchor exists, merge new summary into it (not replace)
Step 5: Persist anchor as a summary part with compactedUntilMessageId marker
Default prompt uses Goal/Instructions/Discoveries/Accomplished/Files template
Test: compaction with 10 messages and retain_turns=2 keeps last 2 verbatim
Test: tool output pruning removes old tool results but keeps tool call names
Test: anchor merge combines two summaries without losing fields

phases.description: Fix toModelMessages() to use anchor as history cutoff
steps: Update toModelMessages() in src/session/message.ts to detect latest anchor
Use anchor's compactedUntilMessageId to skip all messages before that point
Inject anchor summary as first user message (existing pattern)
Test: messages before anchor are excluded from ModelMessage[]
Test: messages after anchor are included verbatim
Test: no anchor = existing behavior unchanged

phases.description: Fix shouldCompact() — estimate current prompt size, not cumulative tokens
steps: Replace cumulative step-finish token sum with prompt size estimation
Estimate using chars/4 heuristic on system prompt + current modelMessages
Compare estimate against model context limit minus output reservation
Test: after compaction, shouldCompact() returns false (not permanently true)
Test: shouldCompact() triggers at correct threshold for known model limits

phases.description: Rewire /compact TUI command to use resolver
steps: Update handleCommand('compact') in src/tui/index.tsx to call resolver instead of compact() directly
Pass trigger: 'command' to resolver
Emit compaction-start and compaction-end events on bus
Test: /compact command triggers compaction and shows status

phases.description: Add compact tool — LLM can request compaction
steps: Create src/tool/compact.ts using defineTool()
Tool calls resolver with trigger: 'tool'
Register tool in bootstrap or profile tools list
Test: tool execution triggers compaction and returns result to LLM

phases.description: Loop integration — auto-trigger and pending execution
steps: Move shouldCompact() check to before the model call in loop() (not after)
Call resolver with trigger: 'auto' when threshold exceeded
Add maybeRunPending() at top of each loop iteration
Remove old inline compaction logic from loop()
Test: auto-trigger fires when context exceeds threshold
Test: pending compaction runs at next loop boundary
Test: loop continues correctly after compaction completes

phases.description: TUI status — show compaction state to user
steps: Add compaction-start and compaction-end events to BusEvents in src/session/events.ts
Wire events to TUI to show compacting indicator
Test: user sees status during compaction
